commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Bo Svensson is stunned as referee Bastian Dankert shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+4' Bastian Dankert couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Anton Stach (Mainz) and blew his whistle.
90+2' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Junior Dina Ebimbe provides Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
86' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) picked up a yellow card from referee.
83' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' Here is a change. Mario Gotze is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt).

82' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
80' The game has come to an end for Philipp Max. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt).
80' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Christopher Lenz (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Hrvoje Smolcic.
80' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' Substitution. Stefan Bell (Mainz) on for Edimilson Fernandes.

79' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Bo Svensson has decided to substitute Phillipp Mwene and he is replaced by Danny da Costa (Mainz).
78' The substitution has been made. Marco Richter has replaced Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz).
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mainz comes to nothing.
75' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.

74' Anton Stach (Mainz) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Kevin Trapp to get hold of the ball. The ball is out of play and Mainz manage to earn a corner.
74' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) unleashes a shot from the free kick, but blazes it over. This is a perfect example of a wasted chance.
73' Dino Toppmoller (Eintracht Frankfurt) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
72' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Bastian Dankert blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Mainz.
70' We are about to witness a substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replacing Randal Kolo Muani.
70' Here comes a substitution. Kristijan Jakic is given a rest as he is replaced by Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt).
70' Bo Svensson decides to make a substitution. Nelson Weiper will be replaced by Brajan Gruda (Mainz).
70' The substitution is prepared. Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Maxim Leitsch.

68' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
64' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) on the edge of the box.
63' A free kick is awarded to Mainz.
63' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
62' Leandro Barreiro Martins (Mainz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
61' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
61' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Bastian Dankert saw the whole situation.
59' Randal Kolo Muani (Eintracht Frankfurt) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net.
59' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) will take the corner.

59' Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick. Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
58' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

58' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted! The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner kick.
57' Anthony Caci (Mainz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
55' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) is booked by the referee.
54' A long cross into the box finds Randal Kolo Muani (Eintracht Frankfurt) unmarked, but his header from the edge of the six-yard box is wild and goes miles wide of the left post.
53' A lofted pass into the box is met by Dominik Kohr (Mainz), who rifles a shot just over the bar.
51' Leandro Barreiro Martins (Mainz) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
49' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
49' Foul! Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Bastian Dankert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Eintracht Frankfurt, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

45+2' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Bastian Dankert stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick has been awarded to Eintracht Frankfurt.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

44' Anthony Caci (Mainz) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Kevin Trapp. This effort really didn't trouble him.
42' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) wastes a huge opportunity from inside the penalty area after unleashing a powerful first-time volley towards goal that goes well wide of the left post.
39' Wonderful movement by Mainz. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
34' Randal Kolo Muani (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
33' Mainz are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
32' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
29' Anthony Caci (Mainz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
25' 1 - 0 A wonderful header! Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) leaps high for a rebound and nicely beats the goalkeeper.
24' The Mainz players can’t believe it after referee Bastian Dankert signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
23' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Mainz! Let's see what he decides.
22' That looked a certain handball by Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
21' Leandro Barreiro Martins (Mainz) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
17' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Now Mainz have a corner.
15' Eintracht Frankfurt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

15' Randal Kolo Muani (Eintracht Frankfurt) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Eintracht Frankfurt.
14' Maxim Leitsch (Mainz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
12' Maxim Leitsch (Mainz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
10' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
7' The resulting corner from Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
7' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
5' Mainz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
3' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

2' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Mainz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' The first half has just begun.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick-off.
Bastian Dankert will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
